data.title: 诱宵美九 · 私人录音室的双人共鸣
data.description: 专业隔音录音室内暖光柔和，美九双手紧紧挽住你的手臂。两人共戴一副监听耳机，她紫发双马尾垂在胸前，紫晶眼眸盈满深情，与你轻声合唱着定情曲。
data.action: sharing studio headphones, clinging to partner arm, singing closely into microphone, loving star-struck gaze
data.lighting: warm moody acoustic studio lights with glowing equipment dials
data.mood: intimate musical harmony, superstar girlfriend romance, tender devotion
data.promptProse: Sharing studio headphones in a cozy recording booth, Miku Izayoi clings to partner arm, singing tenderly with glowing purple eyes.
data.animaCaption: Miku Izayoi singing a sweet duet while sharing headphones in a recording booth.
